item.title: Pakistan vs Sri Lanka Qualification Scenario: What Pakistan Needs to Reach T20 World Cup Semi-Final
item.description: Pakistan vs Sri Lanka qualification scenario explained: the exact Net Run Rate margin Pakistan need to beat New Zealand and reach T20 World Cup 2026 semifinals.

item.title: Arrive Alive Campaign 2026 Phase-II in Cyberabad: Free Eye Tests for Drivers to Improve Road Safety
item.description: Arrive Alive Campaign 2026 Phase-II in Cyberabad offers free eye screening for drivers in Gachibowli to improve road safety and prevent accidents.

item.title: 11kV Electric Pole Falls on Cement Lorry in Chatrinaka: Major Accident Averted in Old City Hyderabad
item.description: 11kV electric pole falls on cement lorry in Chatrinaka Old City Hyderabad during road works; major accident averted, locals allege negligence.

item.title: Vivo Mobile Phone Explosion in Shamshabad: Youth Escapes Major Accident After Device Bursts in Pocket
item.description: Vivo mobile phone explodes in pocket of youth in Shamshabad Hyderabad; quick action prevents major accident near mosque.

item.title: Mule Account Racket Busted in Cyberabad: Four Arrested Including Bank Officials in Cyber Fraud Case
item.description: Mule account racket busted in Cyberabad as cyber crime police arrest four including bank officials; ₹6.67 lakh cyber fraud trail under probe.

item.title: England women’s hockey team reaches Hyderabad for FIH World Cup 2026 Qualifiers
item.description: The top two from each pool advance to the semifinals. The two semifinal winners and bronze medalist qualify, plus the highest-ranked fourth-place finisher across both qualifier events. Matches run at the G. M. C. Balayogi Hockey Ground, with semifinals on March 13 and finals on March 14.

item.title: Bengal SIR: Final voters’ list to be published today, classified under 3 categories
item.description: The ECI has decided to share soft copies of the final list with registered political parties in the state in the interest of transparency. It has also provided multiple options for voters to check the status of their names in the final roll.

item.title: Three killed in hit-and-run accident in Karnataka’s Raichur
item.description: The Sadashiva Nagar police in Bengaluru arrested a 23-year-old software engineer for allegedly knocking down a family of three in a suspected hit-and-run case on New BEL Road in the city on November 13, 2025.

item.title: CM Stalin to launch Rs 1,500 monthly incentive for village temple priests at Mylapore today
item.description: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister M. K. Stalin will participate in a major conference of village temple priests in Mylapore, Chennai, on Saturday, where he is set to distribute welfare assistance and launch a new monthly incentive scheme for priests.

item.title: Infant Found Dead in Water Tank in Telangana’s Nagarkurnool District
item.description: In an attempt to resolve the dispute, a village panchayat was convened earlier in the day to mediate between the two families. However, no resolution was reached, and both sides returned to their respective homes.
